notes.title: Service Closure Announcement
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/9a4e42b40ab6db3291e11cad8c8e2917bfa987d7.jpg[/img]

Hello Winning Putt Community!

After numerous talks with all the teams involved with Winning Putt, it’s with a heavy heart that I’m here to announce Winning Putt will be closing its doors on December 14th of this year.

It’s never easy to announce the closure of a game and it stings even more when it’s one that you’ve had the pleasure to be a part of.

To keep things short, I just want to thank everyone for their continued support throughout the years and it was truly you, the community, who made the game as great as it was.

That said, things aren’t all bad! We will be making some [u]wild[/u] changes in-game to give you the best experience possible as we ride into the sunset. Be sure to keep reading past the Service Closure details to see what we have planned.

[b]Service Closure Details[/b]
[list]	[*]Winning Putt service will officially end on December 14, 2018 at 3:00PM PST. At this point, the official Winning Putt website and forum will no longer be accessible.[/*]	[*]Starting on November 1, 2018 at 3:30PM PDT, Players will be unable to purchase Platinum.[/*]	[*]BANDAI NAMCO Entertainment accounts will continue to be active and can be used for our other titles.[/*]	[*]We will accept refund requests on all Platinum Purchases made between October 1st and November 1st. To request a refund request, please swing over to our [url=https://f2p-support.bandainamcoent.com/hc/en-us]support page[/url] and submit a CS ticket. Refund requests will be processed until December 14th.[/*][/list]
[b]Winning Putt Sunset Event[/b]
[list]	[*]All items that cost Platinum will have their price drastically reduced to help Players clear out their remaining Platinum balances.[/*]	[*]We will also be giving out the items were prepared for this upcoming Winter Season beginning on November 14th. Amongst these items will be something akin to a Founder’s Pack that we were originally going to release later in the month. Keep an eye out for these on the 14th![/*]	[*]250% Bonus Gold and EXP on all Courses will be in effect until December 14th![/*]	[*]Whatever crazy ideas we think of between now and December 14th[/*][/list]
Again, thank you to our community for being awesome and supportive.

--------------

[b]11/05/18 Update: Steam transactions can now be processed through Support Tickets.[/b]

[b]11/01/18 Addition:[/b] For Steam transactions, Players will have to go through Steam to make refunds. We are working on a different solution, but this is more of a Steam-specific issue than a Winning Putt one.

Best,
GM Takkun

notes.title: Scheduled Maintenance Tomorrow on 09/20/18
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/63fb69fb0c9df9efcf1ced618ebd7e8f620af428.jpg[/img]
[h1]Scheduled Maintenance on 09/20/2018 at 3PM PDT[/h1]

Winning Putt will be undergoing scheduled maintenance on Thursday, September 20th, 2018 at 3:00PM PDT (Find your regional equivalent [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=Winning+Putt+Scheduled+Maintenance&iso=20180920T15&p1=224]here[/url]). The game will be unavailable during this time and players will be logged off at the start of the maintenance.

This maintenance will bring The Royal Old Links out of Beta and into the fray! Be sure to check it out in all of your typical competitive modes! We will also be addressing an upgrade to our network infrastructure on the back end. In laymen terms, this should help improve the connection for all Players no matter where they’re playing from!

In addition to our backend updates, our payment processor will also be undergoing maintenance at the same time. Most if not all Players shouldn’t be impacted, but please note that all forms of Platinum Purchasing will be down during maintenance (including purchasing Platinum through the website).

That’s not all! This Maintenance will also close out the current competitive ranked modes and kick off a whole new season for all competitive modes! Be sure to keep an eye out for information on our upcoming tournaments!

For the most up-to-date information be sure to swing over to our forums where we’ll be posting updates right as they happen!

As always, we appreciate your patience and can’t wait to see you back on the green after maintenance!

[i]P.S. We will be distributing the missing gold for Players who participated in the Thornisty Championship B Tournament during Maintenance.[/i]

[i]P.P.S. We are also aware of some Players having connectivity issues outside of the continental United States. We're working with our Service Providers to troubleshoot the issue![/i]

Winning Putt will be undergoing scheduled maintenance on Thursday, June 28th, 2018 from 3:00PM PDT to 7:00PM PDT (Find your regional equivalent [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=Winning+Putt+Scheduled+Maintenance+%5B06%2F28%5D&iso=20180628T15&p1=283&ah=4]here[/url]). In addition, we will also be taking care of some back-of-house updates that are aimed at creating a better experience for all of Players throughout the world! 

As always, we appreciate your patience and can’t wait to see you back on the green after maintenance!

Best,
GM Takkun

P.S. Be on the lookout for teasers coming in July for our next big content update!

notes.title: Scheduled Maintenance Tomorrow / March 29th, 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/ed53803ed2e7d5e7ae563d025944ce217a07d454.jpg[/img]
Winning Putt will be undergoing scheduled maintenance on Thursday, March 29th, 2018 from 3:00PM PST to 7:00PM PDT (Find your regional equivalent [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=Winning+Putt+Scheduled+Maintenance+%5B03%2F29%2F18%5D&iso=20180329T15&p1=283&ah=4]here[/url]). The game will be unavailable during this time and players will be logged off at the start of the maintenance.

This maintenance will bring in Spring by kicking off Easter! ↓ Check out the full details below. ↓

However, the bigger changes coming in with today’s maintenance revolve around the highly anticipated balances to the huge skills overhaul we did a few months back. We’ve been collecting your feedback and have (within reason) used it to guide the changes we’ve made to skills and mentality/stamina consumption.

[b]Happy Easter![/b]
Happy Easter Winning Putt! After maintenance, be sure to take part in the Easter Event that will be running throughout the Month! Tweaking things a little from last year, here’s a breakdown for this year’s Easter Event.

Once the Servers are back online, Players will be awarded Easter Eggs when they score Birdies out on the course. Once you’ve collected enough E, A, S, T, and R eggs, Players can take them to the Craft-o-Matic where they’ll be able to craft some fun Easter items!

Inside of the Craft-o-Matic, Players will find a New Easter Bunny Outfit as well as a new Easter Celebration Box! Both of which can be crafted by combining the eggs you get from shooting birdies out on the course. To open the Easter Celebration Boxes, Players will have to use the Easter Celebration Box Keys which can be obtained through Daily Missions that will reset every 24-hours.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/8a38ce2fc7109ce840e2441b5111151040bbb168.jpg[/img]

In addition to that, Players will be able to directly purchase the Easter Celebration Box for 995 Platinum and the Easter Celebration Box keys for 495 Platinum at the Event Shop.

And just like last year, for all Players who end open at least 50 Boxes, you will receive an improved version of the Easter Bunny Outfit that has better stats! We will make an announcement when we begin distributing them, but expect that toward the end of the month if not early in May.

Easter Egg Locations
[list]
[*]Easter Egg E → Harsh Cape / Starglen
[*]Easter Egg A → Plumeria / Edelweiss
[*]Easter Egg S → Memorial / Breezy Hill
[*]Easter Egg T → Seven Angels / Wildstone
[*]Easter Egg R → Helena / Maiphai Hills
[/list]

[b]Skill Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Rough Wood Shot and Bunker Wood Shot have been changed to Common Skills (Power and Accuracy) and has been replaced with Control Shot 1 for Accuracy Characters.
[*]Accuracy Characters receive a new skill called Smart Spin. Smart Spin will help guide the ball toward the hole when veering off course – kind of like if the ball had a smart spin applied to it. High Stamina / Mentality Consumption.
[*]Straight Shot 1 has been removed and replaced with Straight Shot 2.
[*]Control Shot and Fairway Driver will require less Accuracy overall to unlock the skill.
[*]Accuracy Characters should see a 4% - 6% drop in Stamina and Mentality consumption for all skills.
[*]Power Run has been FIXED. Players should find their shots traveling like before. Higher Stamina / High Mentality Consumption.
[*]Power Characters should see a 5% - 10% reduction in Stamina and Mentality consumption for all skills. Stronger skills will see less of a drop.
[*]We’ve reduced the Stamina and Mentality costs for all Common Skills across the board.
[*]At Level 40, Players should have more freedom to allocate their training points how they feel with the stat requirements for skills being a little more lenient.
[/list]

[b]Guild League and Guild Coin Shop[/b]
With the final test season coming to a close soon, we will be holding a one-week break before the next (and official) Guild League starts! In the meantime, here’s what we have planned on listing in the Guild Coin Shop (tentative to change as well as open to Player suggestions for items moving forward).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/2241d28f42a79c5f8a1bcc187f3bebd245395c7f.jpg[/img]
 
[b]Leftover Hearts[/b]
It’s been delayed due to a few bugs, but we will have a way for all Players to get rid of their leftover Hearts from the Valentine’s Event in-game next Thursday!
Here’s what you’ll find in the Craft-o-matic next week on Thursday.
[list]
[*]1 Yellow Heart can be exchanged for 1 The Heart (3pc)
[*]1 Pink Heart can be exchanged for 1 The Heart (3pc)
[*]1 Red Heart can be exchanged for 1 The Heart (2pc)
[*]1 Yellow, 1 Pink, and 1 Red Heart can be exchanged for 1 Energy Bar
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Pole Physics have been tweaked and a sound effect has been added when your golf ball collides with the pole.
[*]Guild Kiosk bugs have been fixed and Guilds shouldn’t have any issue accessing their Kiosk.
[*]A bug causing some Players to crash / freeze while in the Marketplace has been fixed.
[*]Server Clock has been updated to be more accurate.
[/list]

[b]Additional Notes[/b]
Be sure to pick up your St. Patrick’s Day items as they will be leaving the shop on the 31st at 11:00AM PDT!

As always, we appreciate your patience and can’t wait to see you back on the green after maintenance! Plus, keep an eye out for some new apparel about to make its way to Winning Putt!

notes.title: Letter from the Groundskeeper
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/4365725770e9256cd1a6e261a033c51355cbe98a.jpg[/img]
[h1]Updates on Skills, Guild League, and a few other things![/h1]

Hello Winning Putt Community!

With Spring rolling in quickly and the temperature outside getting warmer every day, we hope that everyone is having a great time on the links both inside of Winning Putt and out on an actual course!

That said, we’ve been hard at work integrating your suggestions and feedback into the game! I apologize that we haven’t been able to get out an update sooner, but it’s taken a lot of work from our Development Team to get things working just right.

And while we’ll have a more comprehensive list of changes in an upcoming Patch Notes, here’s a few important tidbits. First and foremost, we’ll be tweaking the changes that were made to Skills as well as consumption to Stamina and Mentality while you’re out on the course. For the most part, skills won’t require as much Stamina and Mentality. When it comes to the skills themselves, Power Run has been fixed for Power Characters and Accuracy Characters will be receiving a new Tier 2 skill that’ll help them spin the ball in the direction it needs to go. On that note, Accuracy Characters should see their Skills and Shots consuming roughly the same amount as Power Characters (before there was a large discrepancy). 

When it comes to the Guild League, we’re excited to show off the updated prizes as well as Coin Shop which will finally be activated once the Guild League enters its first official Season.

And amongst all of that, we will be holding our typical seasonal events and sales as Spring keeps on rolling in.

As always, we appreciate your patience and understanding as we work to get all of this (and more) out to you guys as soon as possible!
If you have any questions or feedback for us, feel free to swing over to the forums and let us know!

notes.title: Patch Notes [02/08/18]
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/a829bf013a963ef90583c6806080c8930163ce87.jpg[/img]
[h1]Keep yourself up-to-date with all the changes coming to Winning Putt![/h1]

Happy New Year’s Winning Putt Community! It’s been a while since our last Patch Notes, but since then we’ve been tinkering around with things in preparation for today! Listed below are the big changes that are going to be applied after Maintenance and we hope that you’re as excited for them as we are! From new additions to major bug fixes, we’ve covered everything you need to know to golf your best out on the course.

Without further ado, here are the first Patch Notes for 2018!

[b]New Additions[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Guild League[/b]
A new play mode is finally here – the Guild League! Based on feedback we’ve received over the past year, the Guild League is a new mode that allows Guilds to go head-to-head in order to prove just who has the better golfers.

Setup in a similar way to Tournaments, the Guild League is comprised of multiple weeks of competition that fall under one entire Guild League season. Rewards are distributed at the end of every week with a larger reward being distributed at the end of the Season.

So you may be asking – how does the mode itself actually work? It’s quite simple really if you’ve ever played a Foursome mode before. Sharing one ball between each team, Players will try to shoot their best score while working together. One nifty addition designed to aid participants is the addition of the new GPS Marker Feature. This marker will make a clear on-screen mark anywhere on the course to help guide your Partner as you try to sync your shots.

At the end of each Match, you will be awarded points based on your performance. However, in addition to your scorecard, you will also be judged on how well you
actually did against your opponent. From landing the ball closer to the green to sinking the ball in less putts, there are a ton of ways to score points even if you didn’t win the hole!
​
[b]Important Note:[/b] Because this is a new competitive mode that we’re still looking to adjust as time goes on, these first few seasons will be “Beta” or “Test” seasons that will also award different rewards than a typical season would.

[b]Important Note 2:[/b] The Schedule for this first test run of the Guild League will be a little shorter than what we expect will be considered “normal”. Be sure to check out the schedule in-game at the Guild NPC to see the exact times and dates!

We will be asking for feedback throughout the Season so please be sure to send us your honest opinions! Be it through the forums, through a CS ticket, or on Social Media, we are excited to hear what you have to say!

[*][b]Guild Coin Shop[/b]
While we accidentally gave a sneak peek into this new feature, the Guild Coin Shop is finally ready to open! We’ve heard your feedback about trying to spruce up Guilds and the Guild Coin Shop is one of the many features we’re excited to add into the game.

Packed with Consumables, Enchanting Items, Name Change Tickets, and Guild Kiosks, the Coin Shop allows Guild Members to work together to get the items they need! Green Coins (the currency for the Guild Shop) are obtained when Guildmates participate in the Guild League.
 
[b]Important Note:[/b] You may notice that the Guild Coin Shop is still empty. Because the first few seasons of the Guild League will essentially be test runs, the rewards don’t include any of the Coins required to make purchases from the shop. As we get closer to the first official season, we’ll be sure to have all the juicy details in a future Patch Notes or Maintenance Notice!​

[*][b][Chat] Shout Changes[/b]
When you enter the game you may notice that you’re unable to use the Shout channel that we’re all used to utilizing when we’re looking for a slight change of pace (aka a different text color). In addition to another welcome chat box upgrade, we’ve changed the Shout feature slightly.

First and foremost, you’ll be unable to use Shout unless you have the new Disposable Megaphone item in your inventory. At this point in time, this item will only be available through the Guild Coin Shop.

Now you may be wondering – just what the heck does this new Shout feature do and why do I need an item to do it? Well my friends, instead of just showing up as different colored text, the Shout feature will now send your messages to everyone, be it in the Square, in a different Channel, or even in a Round.  Messages sent using this feature will be heard all around the Winning Putt World.

So the next time you’re looking for a game, or trying to find someone to queue with for Time Attack, or just trying to express how happy you are for pulling one stroke ahead during a Ranked Round, be sure to try out the new Shout feature!

[*][b][Chat] Emoji Additions[/b]
An addition that’s been overdue, we’ve finally added in some more modern emojis to the chatbox! Be more expressive as you take on others on the course – these new emotes have a unique character pose associated with them!

[*][b]Skill Changes[/b]
One of the bigger changes coming to Winning Putt this patch are some changes to Skills and how Mentality and Stamina consumption is calculated.

Starting with the skills themselves, Common Skills won’t see any major changes and both Power and Accuracy will still be able to pick from them. That said, some Common Skills are being changed into Class specific skills. In keeping with the theme of both character types, Power Characters are getting Penetrating Shot skill while Accuracy Characters will be receiving the Rough Wood Shot and the Bunker Wood Shot skills.

In addition to these changes, both classes will also be receiving a new skill. For Power Characters, you will see PowerShot 2 once you’ve hit the prerequisite level and stat requirements. PowerShot 2 will provide you a +80 Power Increase to your shot, has no club restrictions, and can be used on any type of terrain. For Accuracy Characters, you’ll see StraightShot 2 as an option. Limited to Irons or Wedges, this skill can be used on any type of terrain and will automatically increase your “Nice Shot” chances.

To account for these changes (as well as make other types of training more appealing), the last change to all of this is the restriction of using one Stamina and one Mentality drink per hole. As we touched on in the Letter from the Groundskeeper, there’s rarely a situation where you wouldn’t use a skill to empower your shot since refilling on Stamina or Mentality was simply one click away. To combat this and create a more dynamic environment, we’re targeting the items that allowed situations like this to exist.

All that said, do not fret! Skills will for the most part will be getting a large reduction on how much Stamina and Mentality they drain. However, a good rule of thumb is if a skill has a large impact, it’ll most likely cost more to use.

Also – there’s now a Daily Mission that will allow Players to obtain Drinks on a more consistent basis.

[*][b]Server Time / Display[/b]
For those of you who didn’t know, you can see what channel you’re currently in by taking a quick peek up in the top right-hand corner of your screen. However, if you keep looking there for a few seconds, you’ll notice that it will loop between showing your channel and the current server time. Something that may not mean much, but should assist Players who have been running into issues when dealing with Daily Missions or rewards.

[*][b]/ping[/b]
The long-awaited ping feature is now here in Winning Putt. Curious if your game is acting up? Wondering whether or not network latency is affecting your shot? Type /ping into your chatbox to check your connection to the Winning Putt servers!

[*][b]New Club Class[/b]
In an effort to continuously respond to the feedback we receive from the entire Player-base, today we’re happy to announce the release of the Indigo Clubs! These new clubs differ from other Clubs in a few significant ways. First and foremost, these clubs will always have a 100% success rate when enchanting. That’s right – these clubs will never fail when you try to enchant them. Second, these clubs can go all the way up to +50 on the enchanting scale. Something that sounds a little crazy on the surface, but isn’t all that bad when you consider that you’ll never fail while enchanting (plus we’ve adjusted the required materials and Gold cost to account for all those extra levels). Last but not least, these clubs will not have a set bonus like other clubs due to the amount of stats they can achieve based on their enchantment level.

To find these new Indigo Clubs, swing over to the Craft-o-Matic where you’ll see them in their entirety, ready to be crafted. That said, you’ll want to swing to the ETC tab where you’ll find Club Boxes for the Advanced Indigos. Now, you may notice that all of these clubs and boxes require the Indigo Trade Ticket to craft. These tickets will be obtainable through a Daily Mission that just requires you to play normally as well as from disenchanting other Indigo Clubs.

In a nutshell, these new clubs are designed to be a long-term investment where anything you put in won’t be lost to random chance.

[b]The Daily Mission to obtain Indigo Tickets will automatically appear once you hit Level 27![/b]

[*][b]Square Decorations Change (Lunar New Years Themed)[/b]
With Winter slowly coming to an end and warmer temperatures coming back, the snow from the Square will be making an exit once the patch is live. Be sure to keep an eye out for a fan favorite that’s temporarily coming back to the Square with a new costume!

[i]Note: We've drastically reduced the amount of fan favorite somethings that load onto the Square to avoid causing lag in the Square.[/i]

[*][b]Character Deletion Timer Changes[/b]
We’re shortening the timers on how long it takes for a character to get deleted. For those of you who are trying to open up Character space, Character Deletion will now only take a total of 2 days.

[*][b]Golf Ball Landing Effects[/b]
To help make your golf ball purchases feel even more valuable, we’ve added some new effects whenever you use Platinum Golf Balls. Keep an eye out for all the cool new effects as you duke it out on the course!
[list][*][i]Balls with updated effects:[/i]
[list][*]Flame Distance
[*]eXtreme Lightning
[*]The Blossom - S
[*]eXtreme Bomber
[*]Hurricane Distance
[*]Bandai Namco Ball
[*]The Alienware
[*]Magical
[*]Electronic
[*]Acid
[*]Confetti
[*]Glacial
[*]Rocket Ball
[*]Rainbow Ball
[*]Soccer Ball Golf Ball
[*]+ 2 New Unreleased Balls
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Valentine’s Day Event[/b]
It’s almost Valentine’s Day and you know what that means – it’s time for some lovey-dovey festivities!

As soon as this new update goes live, we will have turned on the hearts. And by hearts, I mean the temporary Quest Item called Valentine Hearts that you’ll use to turn into snazzy Valentine’s Day clothing!

Every time you shoot a Birdie, you’ll be awarded one of three different hearts based on the course you’re playing on. Once you’ve obtained enough hearts, swing over to the Craft-o-Matic and head to the ETC tab under crafting.

To clarify, the types of heart you receive when shooting a birdie is based on the course you’re playing on and is not random.

We can’t wait to see everyone rocking their new snazzy outfits!

[b]Known Bugs[/b]
[list][*][b]Power Run Skill[/b]
[list][*]We are aware of the issue with Power Run and are trying to solve the issue as quickly as possible. We apologize for the inconvenience. Please avoid using the skill or you may experience a decrease in driving distance when trying to use it.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Gratuitous amounts of text fixes on Missions, Items, and other various UI elements.
[*]Removed the possibility of Snow appearing on Edelweiss.
[*]Fixed a text bug on the Albatross Title.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Pioneer Spacesuit (M) was untradeable after a certain period of time.
[*]Fixed an issue with retry limits not displaying correctly for some Players.
[*]Fixed a graphic issue where Caddies would sometimes disappear.
[*]Fixed multiple issues related to Daily Missions not awarding awards.
[/list]

notes.title: Letter from the Groundskeeper, January 2018
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/9927b5ea13fe5ed2001ef797c17a5d37c12443d3.jpg[/img]
[h1]Your Quarterly Update from Winning Putt![/h1]

Happy New Year’s Winning Putt Community!

It’s been a little while since our last Letter from the Groundskeeper, but boy do we have some exciting news for the next content update!

The biggest of which, is the release of a new game mode! We’ve heard the community asking for more Guild features and we understand that the Guild Missions and Guild Vault have been a sore spot as we continue on tweaking and reiterating on the features. However, we’re proud to announce that Guilds will now be able to participate in a little thing we like to call The Guild League.

The Guild League is a new 2v2 game mode that pits two members from two guilds against each other. And unlike other modes where the scorecard is the only way to judge your performance, this new mode awards points to each Player based on a bunch of different factors. Ranging from landing a better approach than your opponent to closing out a hole in less putts, we wanted to highlight personal performance in addition to just shooting well out on the course. The prize for the Guild League will be Green Coins which can be used at the upcoming Coin Shop that is located in your Guild Menu (which I’m sure you’ve seen by now). The specifics for what will be available haven’t been set yet, but there will be among other items; consumables, lower strength guild kiosks, and more. Keep an eye out for more details once we’re closer to release!

In addition to the Guild League, we are bringing in a pretty big overhaul to the skill system. As skills currently stand, I’m sure we’ve all fallen into the optimal habit of taking a drink to fill up on Stamina or Mentality before selecting any skill at just about any time. In order to bring some variety into the game we’ve tried to address this problem with a two-pronged attack. First, we’re putting a one-per-hole limit on Stamina and Mentality drinks with the hopes that Players will be more inclined to pick and choose when to use skills to achieve what they need. To supplement that change though, we’re also adjusting how much Mentality and Stamina are consumed when you use skills based on their tier as well as your character type. Now you may be asking yourself – tiers? When did skills have tiers? And that my dear Winning Putt Community is something that we’ll be addressing in a post dedicated to the skill changes once they’re closer to being finalized.

Last but not least, we’re also introducing a new type of club. In an effort to change up the enchanting system, these new clubs have a special feature – they will never fail while enchanting. That’s right – these clubs will always have a 100% success chance. The difference between these clubs versus other clubs are that these clubs can go up to +50 versus your typical +10. However, we’ve adjusted the costs for each enchant to be close to the same cost as if you were going for a +10 on a normal set of clubs. In addition to that, these clubs’ stats are designed to stay relevant as you level up meaning they’re clubs that can grow alongside your character! We’ll have a separate post dedicated to these new clubs, full of specific details and in-game images!

Besides the major updates, there are a lot of smaller improvements and changes that’ll all be addressed in the upcoming Patch Notes as we get closer to release. Got questions or feedback for the team? Swing over to the forums and join the discussion!

And as always, we hope you have a great time out on the course!

Best,
GM Takkun and the Winning Putt Team

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/1024706e2543486a875ee2960886c178d4fa788e.jpg[/img]
[h1]Tee off for the Thornisty Championship later today![/h1]

Hello Winning Putt! Later today, come participate in the BNEA Cup as you tee off for the Thornisty Championship! Details for this week’s tournament will be listed below and specifics for the BNEA Cup will be below that!

For Players level 1 through 24, you will be teeing off on Edelweiss while participating on Very Hard Difficulty! Up for grabs is your share of 5,000,000 Gold and 5,000 Ranked Tournament Points! To participate and be eligible for prizes (including the BNEA Cup Apparel), players must pay a 30,000 Gold Entry Fee and complete all 18 Holes of the tournament.  

For players level 25 and above, you will be teeing off on Harsh Cape while playing on Very Hard! Up for grabs is your share of 10,000,000 Gold and 5,000 Ranked Tournament Points! To participate and be eligible for prizes (including the BNEA Cup Apparel), players must pay a 30,000 Gold Entry Fee and complete all 18 holes of the tournament.

For both the Lower Level and Higher Level tournaments, Players will be limited to a total of 2 retries giving them a grand total of 3 attempts at the tournament. We will be collecting feedback at the end of the BNEA Cup, but be sure to exercise caution when going for a retry!

The Thornisty Championship will come to a close at 1:00PM PST / 9:00PM UTC on December 28st, 2017. After this time, players will be unable to enter the tournament.

Players unsatisfied with their initial score may purchase a re-participation ticket from the Support Shop for 5,000 Gold or 150 Platinum. With this ticket, players will be allowed to re-participate in the tournament and their current score will be replaced with their next round of golf regardless of whether their new score is better or not.

Don’t fall behind as we get closer and closer to the end of the BNEA Cup!

[b]BNEA Cup Details[/b]
Just like prior seasons, the BNEA Cup will pit Players against each other as they try to shoot their best possible score to claim the top spot at the end of the Season. Unlike other prior seasons, the top three Players from the Lower and Higher Level Tournaments will be awarded their choice of an exclusive USA or EU Jacket and Cap. These pieces of Apparel will not be available for purchase and are only obtainable by participating in the BNEA CUP!

In addition to the main prizes, we will also be giving away an additional 24 Caps to Players who have participated in at least One Tournament. We’ll be splitting it up by giving away 12 Caps to anyone who participated in the Lower Level Tournaments and 12 to those who participated in the Higher Level Tournament!

BNEA Cup Apparel will be distributed once the BNEA Cup ends.
We will be providing more specifics in a later News Post on how Winners can claim their items.

notes.title: Scheduled Maintenance on 12/14/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/49602940ab86147a66eee20e80878aa13cada86e.jpg[/img]
[h1]Scheduled Maintenance on 12/14/2017 from 3PM to 7PM PST[/h1]

Winning Putt will be undergoing scheduled maintenance on Thursday, December 14th, 2017 from 3:00PM PST to 7:00PM PST (Find your regional equivalent [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=Scheduled+Maintenance+for+Winning+Putt+%5B12%2F14%2F2017%5D&iso=20171214T15&p1=283&ah=4]here[/url]). The game will be unavailable during this time and players will be logged off at the start of the maintenance.

With the Winter Holidays in full swing, we’re bringing back a more festive look to the Square. Full of snow, presents, and even reindeer, make sure to bundle up tightly when you’re out and about on the Square. In addition to the festivities, here are a list of some changes and fixes coming in with this week’s maintenance.

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Tournaments will now have a limited amount of retries. Make sure to check out each Tournament’s news post for the full details of how many retries are allowed!
[*]Snow is descending upon the Square! Be on the lookout for fancy Winter effects and Christmas inspired music!
[*]Edelweiss will not have snow on it this year.
[*]Just like Hole-in-Ones and Eagles, Albatross Rewards are falling in line and are now rewarded through Daily Missions.
[*]Not sure if you whacked the Flag Pole or not? We’ve made it more clear with new effects and a unique sound if you manage to hit the Pole!
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where Blocked Players were able to send invites out to those who blocked them.
[*]Fixed a bug where Lucky Box Items got stuck if a Player’s inventory was full.
[*]Stat Bonuses from Titles now appear properly in the “My Info” window.
[*]Pirate Costumes no longer have a limit on how many times they can be patched.
[*]Alpine Outfits no longer have a limit on how many times they can be patched.
[*]Chloe Caddie Contracts no longer show incorrect time left.
[*]The Guild Vault should no longer reset the amount of Gold that's withdrawable to zero.
[list]
[*]Note: Once a Guild Member has withdrawn up to their limit, they will be unable to withdraw more until the Guild Master re-applies a limit again.
[/list]
[*]Various text fixes.
[/list]
As always, we appreciate your patience and can’t wait to see you back on the green after maintenance!

For the most update information, be sure to swing over to the [url=http://forums.winningputtgame.com/]forums[/url]. While you're there, why not stay for a little and introduce yourself to the community? :)

notes.title: Scheduled Maintenance Tomorrow!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/45e6eeb7e8b86ba7673488a21d7afe5694f869ff.jpg[/img]
[h1]Scheduled Maintenance on 11/30/2017 from 3PM to 7PM PST[/h1]


Winning Putt will be undergoing scheduled maintenance on Thursday, November 30th, 2017 from 3:00PM PST to 7:00PM PST (Find your regional equivalent [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=Winning+Putt+Scheduled+Maintenance+%5B11%2F30%2F17%5D&iso=20171130T15&p1=283&ah=4]here[/url]). The game will be unavailable during this time and players will be logged off at the start of the maintenance.

This maintenance will close out the current Ranked Round and Time Attack Seasons, distribute rewards, and kick off brand new seasons for each! In addition to that the BNEA Cup will also be kicking off once the servers are back online from maintenance! For the BNEA Cup, be sure to check out the News Post coming tomorrow that highlights some of the differences between our typical tournament (like the prizes!).

We also have a few bug fixes also sneaking their way into this maintenance. Specifically, we’re addressing a bug that was causing some Players to be unable to reclaim their name after deleting their character and a bug where larger Guilds were unable to invite new members.

Behind the scenes we’ll be making more improvements to the backend as well as working on making sure your connection to Winning Putt is as stable as possible.

As always, we appreciate your patience and can’t wait to see you back on the green after maintenance!

Best,
GM Takkun

notes.title: The Final Tournament of Season 9
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/85d6ccddb20cbd58a9d71ca15fd1940fd10e8fb0.jpg[/img]
[h1]Ready or not, here comes the Volero Championship![/h1]

After five grueling weeks of competition, today marks the start of the final tournament of the 9th season of the Volero Tour. Later today, players will be teeing off on either Edelweiss or Harsh Cape as they try their best to shoot the lowest score possible for the Volero Championship! With a ton of Gold and Ranked Tournament Points at stake, don't miss this chance to leave your mark on Winning Putt history!

For players between levels 1 and 24, you will be teeing off on Edelweiss while participating on Normal Difficulty! Up for grabs is your share of 5,000,000 Gold and 10,000 Ranked Tournament Points. To participate and be eligible for prizes, players must pay a 5,000 Gold entry fee and complete all 18 holes of the tournament. 

For players level 25 and above, you will be teeing off on Harsh Cape while playing on Very Hard! Up for grabs is your share of 15,000,000 Gold and 10,000 Ranked Tournament Points! To participate and be eligible for prizes, players must pay a 50,000 Gold entry fee and complete all 18 holes of the tournament.

The Volero Championship will come to a close at 1:00PM PST / 7:00PM UTC on November 23rd, 2017. After this time, players will be unable to enter the tournament.

Players unsatisfied with their initial score may purchase a re-participation ticket from the Support Shop for 5,000 Gold or 150 Platinum. With this ticket, players will be allowed to re-participate in the tournament and their current score will be replaced with their next round of golf regardless of whether their new score is better or not.

Good luck to all the players out there trying to become the winner of the Volero Tour! Once this season comes to a close, there will be a one week break as we prep for the upcoming BNEA Cup! For those of you who need competition in your lives, Ranked Rounds and Time Attack will still be going!

Don't wait until it's too late -- take part in the Volero Championship later today!

notes.title: Patch Notes (September 2017)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/240967b5e75c80b44389a9fd3b2eefc3f53db799.jpg[/img]

[h1]Read up on all the upcoming changes coming to Winning Putt![/h1]

Hello Winning Putt Community! With the temperatures falling and the cool breeze of fall flowing around us, I'm proud to release the next set of Patch Notes for the third content update of 2017! Listed below is all the juicy information you've been waiting for. From new additions to the game to major bug fixes, we've covered everything you need to know to kick some butt out on the course.

[h1]New Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]The Guild Vault[/b]
[list]
[*]It's been a long time coming, but we're happy to announce that a Guild Vault has been added to the game! Essentially storage for Guilds, the Guild Vault offers a convenient way for Guilds to collect and distribute gold, facilitate storage, and provide a way for members to store things they otherwise may not have space for. All the while providing the Guild security and peace of mind with the ability to set different permissions for who can access what.
[*]For a more detailed look at the Guild Vault, keep scrolling down!
[/list]

[*][b]Improvements to Power Characters[/b]
[list]
[*]Power Characters are getting some changes in this upcoming content update.
Simply put:
[list]
[*]Making it easier for them to land a NICE shot.
[*]Decreasing the overall GPS Circle Size compared to before.
[*]Increasing how much distance the Power stat provides, slightly decreasing the amount Swing provides.
[/list]
[*]Overall, we're aiming to make Power Characters truly embrace that "high risk, high reward" theme they were supposed to embody.​
[*][i]We will be distributing Retraining Tickets to all Players who sign in between Thursday and Sunday![/i]
[/list]

[*][b]Revamped Achievements[/b]
[list]
[*]Something we've been working on for a while, the new revamped achievements come with updated text, a brand new UI window, and most importantly updated stats associated with the title you receive for completing achievements!
[/list]
​
[*][b]Eagle Missions Separated[/b]
[list]
[*]Small quality of life change -- the Daily Eagle Missions has been changed to Shoot One Eagle, Get One Eagle Box that can be done a total of 3 times per day. (We're still working on getting the missions awarding completion during all modes of play)
[/list]
 
[*][b]Betting Rounds Gold Limit Increased[/b]
[list]
[*]One of the most sacred parts of Golf is the unspoken rule of constantly trying to take money away from your buddies as you're playing the course. The max gold betting limit in Betting Rounds has been increased (a lot) to help facilitate this in-game.
[/list]

[*][b]PIN PHYSICS[/b]
[list]
[*]Why is the title in all caps? Because today is a glorious day that marks the introduction of Pin Physics to Winning Putt. Just like in real-life, use the pole to your advantage (or hope it plays to your opponent's disadvantage) as you try to hit the perfect shot.
[/list]

[*][b]Character Slot Increase[/b]
[list]
[*]We're increasing the maximum number of character slots from 2 to 3. To unlock the 3rd spot, pick up the new Character Slot Expansion item sold at the Support Agency!
[/list]

[*][b]Level Up Support Box [for Lower Players][/b]
[list]
[*]We haven't forgotten about our lower level players! In addition to the split tournaments (which we've adjusted a bit), Players under level 20 will now receive a nice bonus in the form of a gift box at levels 1, 5, 8, 11, 13, 16, and 20! This box will contain consumables, caddie contracts, and a few other nice gifts to help lower level players shoot their best out on the course.
[/list]

[*][b]Toggle-able Putting Grids[/b]
[list]
[*]Not the biggest change, but hopefully a welcome one on some courses where the putting grid or the GPS can get pretty annoying. Starting as soon as maintenance is over, you can now toggle the putting grid or the GPS on or off to help your eyes take a breather on some of the harsh uphill putts. Press "o" while in a round to try it out!
[/list]

[*][b]Craft-o-Matic Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Now when a player is trying to craft a club, they'll have the option to select which club is being used if they have more than one in their inventory. No more having your +7 Driver being gobbled up when you wanted the basic, non-shafted, non-enchanted one being used. To change the club you're using, click the club in the Craft-o-Matic window to bring up club selection window.
[/list]

[*][b]New Apparel[/b]
[list]
[*]More details will be announced as they're released, but we have a lot of new apparel for you to pick from with the seasons changing. For some hints though, one of the outfits has a clear wrangler feel to it while another has a very royal type of style going on.
[/list]

[*][b]Alienware AlienFX Effects[/b]
[list]
For players running on Alienware machines, Winning Putt now has AlienFX integrated into the game! Whenever you take a shot, the lights on applicable systems and peripherals will react accordingly!
​[/list]

[*][b]New Tour Banners[/b]
[list]
[*]We've slightly changed where the banners are hanging and have added a new banner to display the winners for the new Split Tournament setup!
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Known Bugs[/h1]
[list]
[*]Level Up Support Boxes currently have a bug where opening them may occasionally yield the incorrect number of items. Fix: Be sure not to have any of the items that the box contains in your inventory while opening. For example, if you have 50 yellow bolts and the box contains yellow bolts, make sure to remove the yellow bolts from your inventory temporarily before opening the box!

[*]Caddies with Hole Durations incorrectly show holes left as seconds remaining. The counter is accurate, but confusing (if you have 100 Holes left, it incorrectly says 100 Seconds). The amount of holes remaining will be correct!

[*]Caddies with Hole Durations currently do not update the counter mid-round. Once you've finished / exited a round, the amount of Holes remaining will update correctly.

[*]Occasionally the tooltips in the new Achievement window may stick. Opening and closing the Achievement window will clear any stuck tooltips.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Repeatedly pressing the Renew button on a Caddie Contract won't eat all your Platinum now.
[*]Fringe cases where Lucky Ball gauge would get stuck at 100% has been fixed.
[*]Guild Missions showing incorrect Guild Members has been addressed.
[*]Fixed situations where an opponent leaving a Ranked Round would cause the other player to lose points.
[*]Fixed a bug where glasses were not appearing correctly over certain pieces of clothing.
[*]Fixed a bug where chat messages from the "Companion" chat were visible in all chat filters.
[/list]

[h1]Feature Guide: The Guild Vault[/h1]
[i]Click [url=http://res.cloudinary.com/takkun/image/upload/v1505863726/guild_vault_feature_guide_optimized_at6zka.jpg]here[/url] to open the Guide in a new window!

[img]http://res.cloudinary.com/takkun/image/upload/v1505863726/guild_vault_feature_guide_optimized_at6zka.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Letter From The Groundskeeper, September 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/b4723a1c70da3629aa474ab6bce2709d968fe22c.jpg[/img]
[h1]Find out what's coming to Winning Putt![/h1]

Hello Winning Putt Community! It’s been a little while since our last letter, but boy do we have some interesting things to talk about in this one. With a lot of changes (maybe adjustment is a better word) heading to Winning Putt, we’ll try our best to give you some insight into what’s going on.
 
First and foremost, coming with the next content update is the promised update to Power Characters. After a long and hard fought debate on how to give Power players a more established identity, we took things back to the basics -- give Power players the ability to drive the ball further than Accuracy characters without completely losing the ability to somewhat control where their ball will land. On the flip side, we also realize that Accuracy characters are [currently] able to drive the ball nearly  as far as Power characters without sacrificing too much in terms of control. In order to solve the problem as a whole, here’s a rough idea of what’s coming:
[list]
[*]Making it easier for Power Characters to land a NICE shot.
[*]Decreasing the GPS Circle Size for Power Characters based on their Power Stat / Training.
[*]Adjusting how much distance Power and Swing stats provide (Bumping up Power, lowering Swing).
[*]Slightly Increasing the GPS Circle Size for Accuracy Characters toward the latter levels. (Based on changes to how GPS circle sizing works)
[*]Making it slightly easier for Accuracy Characters to land a NICE shot.
[/list]
As a whole, Accuracy Players shouldn’t notice any significant changes while Power Players should begin to start driving their balls further while also having an easier time at controlling where their balls land. In a competitive sense, we're aiming to get Power Characters up to snuff so that they can start kicking butt out on the course.
 
Now, don’t fret if you thought this next update was just focused on Power Characters. Besides the aforementioned changes, we have a bunch of other features making their way into the game. The biggest that come to mind is the creation of Guild Storage (full details on that coming in a later post), Eagle Missions being split into 3 separate missions, removing White Bolts from Season Rewards, increasing the maximum bet amount in Betting Mode, and a lot of fun and varied cosmetics to help bring in the fall and winter seasons with a bang!
 
Remember, this letter is just a glance at what’s coming and doesn’t include [i]everything[/i]. As we get closer to the release of the next update, we’ll be back with more posts about specific features that’ll have the juicy details you’re looking for!
 
As always, we hope you have fun out on the course and can’t wait to be back with more updates~

notes.title: Scheduled Maintenance This Thursday
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/ab92eac4a8d1f4e7f03ed50cec15afe81684fe7c.jpg[/img]
[h1]Scheduled Maintenance on 08/03/2017 from 3PM to 7PM PDT[/h1]

Winning Putt will be undergoing scheduled maintenance on Thursday, August 3rd, 2017 from 3:00PM PDT to 8:00PM PDT (Find your regional equivalent [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=Winning+Putt+Scheduled+Maintenance+on+08%2F03%2F17&iso=20170803T15&p1=886&ah=4]here[/url]). The game will be unavailable during this time and players will be logged off at the start of the maintenance.

This maintenance is to address ongoing issues that players have been seeing as well as making a slight change to certain modes. For more information on the specifics of what’s coming, keep reading!

[h1]Changes / Bug Fixes:[/h1][list]
[*][b]Marketplace Search Functionality Repaired![/b]
[list]
[*]Searching in the Marketplace has been repaired! No longer will you have to flip through page after page trying to find the item you’re looking for. In addition, the “infinity” bug some players have seen has been addressed as well!
[/list]
[*][b]Season 7 Banners are In![/b]
[list]
[*]The banners around the square have all been updated to accurately reflect the correct players who attained the highest scores for Season 6 of the Volero Tour.
[/list]
[*][b]Advanced The Distance Club Set Bonuses[/b]
[list]
[*]The missing set bonuses have been found and anyone who owns the Advanced versions of The Distance Clubs should see them right where they used to be.
[/list]
[*][b]Wind Changes In Certain Modes[/b]
[list]
[*]After the community discovered a certain method of utilizing Challenge Rounds and Course Mastery to “farm” Eagle and Albatross rewards, we’ve made a few changes to these modes. The biggest of which is having the Wind slightly change each time you attempt the course. In general, most players shouldn’t notice any difference in play except that it’ll be more difficult to approach the same hole the same exact way every time :)
[/list]
[/list] 
[h1]Known Bugs:[/h1][list]
[*][b]Blue Schematic Box Animations[/b]
[list]
[*]This is purely a visual bug, the amount of letters you receive is correct and will be sitting in your inventory.
[/list]
[*][b]Daily Mission Completion[/b]
[list]
[*]We’re still looking into why some players are having trouble with their missions completing, but if you know you’ve finished your Daily Mission but can’t get it to progress, simply head to Character Select and come back. Once you’ve reloaded in the Square, the mission should be completed!
[/list]
[/list]
As always, we appreciate your patience and understanding! See you after Maintenance!

Best,
GM Takkun

notes.title: Albatross Farming Notice
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/e10b36e3a143bed93c8c113ee835efaceea46c0d.png[/img]
[h1]Official Word from the WP Team[/h1]

Hello Winning Putt Community!

We’ve noticed a sharp rise in the number of Albatrosses being scored recently and while we appreciate players trying their best to push the system as far as it can go, it’s tough for us to ignore the large amount of announcements that have been flooding chat recently.

We’re currently working on a slight mechanic change to address the issue moving forward, but until those changes are set in stone, we are asking players to stop utilizing certain modes and methodologies to farm Albatross reward boxes.

[b]Specifically, we are going to begin punishing players who continue to utilize certain features and modes outside of their intended functionality.[/b] This News Post is serving as everyone’s official notice as well as the first and final warning to please stop.

As always, we appreciate your patience as we work on resolving this situation as quickly as possible.

P.S. There’s nothing to worry about if you score an Albatross normally. We know that, while difficult, it’s not impossible to land these tough shots and we can clearly differentiate things from the back end.

notes.title: Scheduled Maintenance
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/7b1fb2719d4b8609fa75bea886d2484f204757db.jpg[/img]
[h1]Winning Putt will be undergoing scheduled maintenance on Thursday, July 20th, 2017 from 3:00PM PDT to 7:00PM PDT![/h1]

Winning Putt will be undergoing scheduled maintenance on Thursday, July 20th, 2017 from 3:00PM PDT to 7:00PM PDT (Find your regional equivalent [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=Winning+Putt+Scheduled+Maintenance+on+07%2F20%2F17&iso=20170720T15&p1=886&ah=4]here[/url]). The game will be unavailable during this time and players will be logged off at the start of the maintenance.

This maintenance will address the last bits of wonky issues that players have been seeing as well as adding in some long standing changes that players have been asking for. 

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Bolt Stacks have been increased to 200 per stack.
[*]Max Marketplace Listings have been increased to 14 items.
[*]Eagle and Hole-In-One Rewards have transitioned into Daily Missions.
[*]Tournament Banners have been updated.
[*]Putters requirements have been removed from Club Set requirements.
[*]Blocking another Player should prevent all communication.
[/list]
[b]Known Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]We’re aware of the search function being broken in the Marketplace. A fix is in the works.
[/list]

While this is far from the entirety of what we’re working on, we’re pushing the team to put more emphasis on the wants and needs of the community. With many quality-of-life changes in the pipeline (in addition to overhauls of certain systems), we’re hoping that these changes included in the incremental updates helps makes everyone’s life easier.

[b]Eagle and Hole-in-One Rewards[/b]

This one has been a hot topic on the forums since the last big update and we finally have an update on what’s going on. In an effort to help curb the farming of these rewards, we’ve decided (for now) to put them behind Daily Missions as we work out a system to provide scaling rewards based on how difficult it was to actually get that Eagle or Hole-in-One. The rewards themselves will be going back to the original ones and all players will have the ability to obtain a limited amount of Eagle and Hole-in-One boxes per day.
With this change, players won’t receive a reward (for now) for shooting an Eagle or Hole-in-One. Albatross rewards are unaffected by this change (except for having their rewards reverted) but we are currently reviewing the ability of these rewards being unfairly farmed under certain situations.
Note: Currently, it is a known bug that the Hole-in-One mission comes after completing the Eagle mission. This is not intended and will be fixed as soon as possible.
​
[b]Tournament Banners[/b]

This one is a big one for me since it takes a lot for Players and Guilds to fight for the top spot through each season. The ability for the Winning Putt team to change banners is almost here, but more information on that once it’s actually live. Please note that the top Player and Guild banners will be incorrect until the next maintenance due to certain limitations.
​
[b]Putters removed from Club Set Bonuses[/b]

With some cool plans for clubs and putters in the future, we’re just cleaning things up by removing Putters as a requirement for the set bonuses. Now you can enjoy putting with your favorite putter and not have to worry about messing up your stat bonuses!
 
[b]Blocking Players[/b]

We try our best to promote a welcoming and safe environment for all our players, but sometimes you meet someone who just doesn’t want to see eye-to-eye with you. After receiving feedback on the current muting/blocking system, we’re tuning things up so you can truly avoid contact with people who you don’t want to interact with. Completely blocking someone (like their existence) is in the works and will hopefully come out sometime in the future!
As always, we appreciate your patience and understanding and can’t wait to see you back out on the green!

Be sure to keep an eye on the [url=forums.winningputtgame.com]forums[/url] throughout maintenance for any updates!

[h1]New Features & Updates[/h1]
[b]Guild Mission System[/b]
[list]
[*]You’ve been asking for it and we’re here to deliver! This update ships with the New Guild Mission System, a completely separate set of missions that are focused about guild mates participating together to complete them! They have pretty hefty rewards, but will be tough to complete without the collective effort of your guild.
[*]Missions themselves vary and could be anything from achieving birdie 1,000 times (as a guild) to driving the ball over 300,000 yards (again, as a guild).
[*]Scroll down for more information!
[/list]
[b]Guild Max Level and Max Members Increased[/b]
[list]
[*]The guild level cap has been increased to 30!
[*]The guild member cap has also been increased to 50!
[/list]
​[b]Item Transfer between characters on the same account[/b]
[*]We’ve tweaked the mail system and have added the ability for you to send mail to the characters on your account! Instead of having to find a middleman, you can now safely transfer things between your characters. As an added bonus, you can even use this new system as a pseudo storage system for items you don’t necessarily want in your inventory.​[/list]
[b]Marketplace Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]We’ve tidied up the Marketplace with some quality-of-life improvements to help both buyers and sellers feel confident when listing a product. Besides tweaks to help with visibility of important equipment information (and a pop-up to confirm you really want to buy the item you’ve selected), we’ve also prevented players from listing items that have been used (aka no more used shiny stones).[/list]
[b]Guild Kiosk Buff Timer Increased to 2 Hours[/b]
[list]
[*]Addressing the issue of the Guild Kiosk Buff wearing off before you’d be able to complete an 18-hole round, we’ve doubled the timer’s time to 2 hours to make sure you get the proper bonuses while you’re on the course.​[/list]
[b]Club Crafting Change[/b]
[list]
[*]Big changes are coming for players who are interested in crafting clubs through the Craft-o-matic.
[*]Schematics for specific types of clubs have been replaced with schematics for brands of clubs (Vedas and TINQ). These schematics can be used in crafting any clubs from their respective brand, depending on the grade of the schematic. New Schematic Lock Box items contain Schematic Letter items of different grades which can be used to craft the schematics of the same grade. Vedas schematics require the letters “V”, “E”, “D”, “A”, and “S” while TINQ clubs require the letters “T”, “I”, “N”, and “Q”. Schematic Lock Boxes can be obtained as a possible Lucky Ball reward for players starting at level 26.
[*]Schematics that players currently own can be converted to Vedas schematics of the same grade for a small Gold fee at the Craft-o-Matic.
[*]Schematic Lock Boxes will be available through Lucky Ball Drops or purchasable at the Event Shop.​[/list]
[b]TINQ Clubs Added[/b]
[list]
[*]“The Distance” clubs can be used by level 31 or higher characters and have a heavy emphasis on Swing. A “Club Schematic: Tinq” of the appropriate grade (along with other relevant crafting materials) will be needed to craft these clubs.​[/list]
[b]Season Rewards are being updated[/b]
[list]
[*]Ranked Round: All “Schematic Box” items now contain the new “Club Schematic: Vedas” and “Club Schematic: Tinq” items instead of the previous club-specific schematics.  The items that can be obtained from these boxes are of the same grade as the previous rewards. For example, the “Premium Club Schematic Box” will now award either a “Premium Club Schematic: Tinq” or “Premium Club Schematic: Vedas” instead of a Premium schematic for a specific type of club.​[/list]
[b]Guild Banners have been Updated![/b]
[list]
[*]Pretty self-explanatory.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Lucky Ball Gauge[/b]
[list]
[*]While we’ve quietly been rolling in fixes throughout the past month, the release of this new build should mark the end of all those wonky Lucky Ball Gauge issues that some players were experiencing.[/list]
[b]National Shirts for Gold[/b]
[list]
[*]Stats have been properly added to the bugged National Shirts and they should be available in the Apparel Shop shortly after Winning Putt comes back online from maintenance.[/list]
[b]Premium GPS Wind Arrows[/b]
[list]
[*]Arrows representing wind direction have been fixed and now appear properly when using the Premium GPS.[/list]
​[b]Stray White Pixels[/b]
[list]
[*]We’ve removed the stray pixels that some players were seeing on the Square and on various in-game menus.[/list]
​[b]Bonus EXP from Sponsorships or Kiosks[/b]
[list]
[*]Tweaked the backend to make sure the amount of Bonus EXP awarded is accurate.[/list]
​[b]Non-Tradeable Premium GPS from the shop[/b]
[list]
[*]Has now been fixed and is always tradeable.[/list]
[b]Known Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]Visual Bug, Blue Letter Lockboxes animation only shows one during box opening. Player receives correct amount.
[*]Visual Bug, Players may occassionally see the golf ball clip into certain areas after shooting a ball out of bounds.[/list]

[h1]Guild Missions[/h1]
[i]Are you ready to be the very best that there ever was?[/i]

With our next update release comes a big new feature: [b]Guild Missions![/b]

These missions are completely separate from your personal missions and require the collaborative effort of your entire guild to complete. With big rewards at stake, will your guild be able to persevere and claim the top prizes?

To put it simply, Guild Missions are a new feature that are designed to reward guilds who get their members to support one another as they try to reach a weekly goal. These goals could be hitting the ball over 300,000 yards to achieving 1,000 birdies.

Everything you need to know about these Guild Missions can be found under the new Guild Mission tab within the Guild Menu.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/38f0f513df07f1ab9de28d129dce43923ac0f288.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]1. Mission Objective & Time Remaining: Your guild’s current mission and how long you have left to reach the goal. These missions will change every week and your guild will be rewarded based on many steps your guild manages to clear.
[*]2. Step and Progress Bar: The Step shows how far up the ladder your guild is currently at (clearing more steps means better prizes) and the Progress Bar shows how many more completion points you need to clear the current step.
[*]3. Members / Rewards: The members tab will show each guild member’s contributions to the Guild Mission. The Rewards tab will show all the steps and what the reward is for completing that step.
[list]
[*]There is a limit to how much a single member can contribute to the Guild Mission. This limit is the “limit point” and is double the amount that each guild member is expected to contribute.[/list]
[*]4. Reward Bonuses: The Reward Bonus section will show what bonus multipliers the Guild has reached and any additional rewards that the Guild obtains. Only the most cohesive Guild will obtain the top rewards and bonuses!
[*]5. Previous Mission Info: This tab will bring up the previous mission’s information as well as allow the Guild Leader to claim the reward for the Guild Mission once the next one begins. Note that the Guild Leader will be the one who receives the reward and it will be up their discretion how to distribute it.
​[/list]
[b]Extra Important Points[/b]
[list]
[*]No Guild Mission points will be rewarded if you quit mid-round.
[*]Foursome and Fourball (unless specified) will not gain you Guild Mission Points.
[*]Shooting in the Driving Range will not provide you with Guild Mission Points.
[*]Once you’ve reached your Point Limit, you can no gain any extra points until the next mission begins.
[/list]

[h1]Club Crafting 2.0[/h1]
[i]We’re making some changes to Club Crafting![/i]

Here's a brief primer on the changes coming to Club Crafting set to debut in the next content update. In a nutshell, we’re trying to make crafting a bit easier in the long run, especially if there’s a certain club you’re trying to get.

To kick things off we’re revamping how Schematics work and how you obtain Schematics for the type of club you want. In a nutshell we’re reducing the variation and total number of Schematics so it’s easier to obtain the one you want. By separating schematics by grade and brand instead of club, you’ll be able to use schematics for any type of club within a specific set.

Sound confusing? Let’s dive into an example.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/6a8b2706d9a44566d2567af59bc5b2af6cdd26cb.jpg[/img]
Using the [Advanced] Ultra G-Speed G DR (a Vedas branded club) as an example, you’ll need the following items to craft it: 374 Titanium Alloy Rods, 64 Advanced Club Cartridges, and the new Advanced Club Schematic: Vedas schematic.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/7eaf1b4c5b0d577c909fd63f4905771aa62d4eb2.jpg[/img]
This schematic is not club specific and will be the same one you use if you also wanted to craft any other club like an iron or even a putter!
[i]* Expert and Premium clubs still require the previous club in order to craft them in addition to the Expert or Premium versions of the schematic.*[/i]

[b]Crafting Schematics[/b]
Now, you may be wondering – How do I craft these new schematics? And what about the schematics I already have?

Starting with the former, we’re introducing new Schematic Letters that you’ll obtain from opening Schematic Lock Boxes. These Lock Boxes will be obtainable as Lucky Ball Drops or purchasable for Platinum.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/99b2b7457296e16b95dd76ca55aba3cdf3c5b686.jpg[/img]
When opening these different boxes, you’ll be awarded Schematic Letters that could be Advanced, Expert, or Premium grades depending on the box. And once you’ve collected the right letters (TINQ for Tinq clubs or VEDAS for Vedas Clubs), you’ll be able to craft the corresponding schematic based on the grade of the letters.

[i]* Yes, the schematics for each respective brand will be crafted by spelling out their name.*[/i]
[i]* Currently, there is a visual bug where Blue Lock Boxes only show 1 letter being given. The correct amount will appear in your inventroy. *[/i]

Now, for the elephant in the room – what happens to the schematics I already have? Unfortunately, they won’t be useable with the new crafting system. [b]However[/b], you’ll be able to convert any schematics into the corresponding grade Vedas schematic! So if you have an Expert Putter schematic you’ll be able to convert it into an Expert Club Schematic: Vedas which can then be used for any club!

And there you have it! With the goal of simplifying things in mind, we’re excited to see just how many more players are able to craft the clubs they’ve had their eyes on. As always we’re open to feedback and will be eagerly waiting to see what you have to say on the forums and through our social media!

notes.title: Volero Challenge by GravyBeast
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/2bb24f5b697186e0b7d4a6c3ea5b0cff0d119bb9.jpg[/img]
[h1]Season 6 of the Volero Tour Starts Today! Take part in the Volero Challenge![/h1]

After a fierce competition throughout the month of May, we’ve tallied the points and I’m proud to crown GravyBeast as the Season 5 Champion! Make sure to congratulate GravyBeast if you see them in-game!

Once Winning Putt returns from scheduled maintenance, we’re going to kick off Season 6 of the Volero Tour with the Volero Challenge by GravyBeast! Open to anyone and everyone, players will be teeing off on the windy slopes of Breezy Hill on Very Easy difficulty for their share of 10,000,000 Gold and 5,000 Ranked Tournament Points!

To participate, players are required to pay a 30,000 Gold entry fee and must complete all 18 holes to be eligible for prizes. The Volero Challenge by GravyBeast will run until June 1st, 2017 at 1:00PM PDT / 8:00PM UTC.

Players unsatisfied with their initial score may purchase a re-participation ticket from the Support Shop for 5,000 Gold or 150 Platinum. With this ticket, players will be allowed to re-participate in the tournament and their current score will be replaced with their next round of golf regardless of whether the new score it better or not.

With the slates cleared, now’s the time to make your mark and begin your journey to become the Season 6 Champion!

notes.title: Letter From The Groundskeeper, May 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/15e04a112b99bc6605c70922544e5149554b8b43.jpg[/img]
[h1]Your monthly update about all things Winning Putt![/h1]

Hello Winning Putt Community!

With Easter over and the summer heat rolling in, let’s cool things off with a nice and breezy Letter from the Groundskeeper! The next scheduled content update will focus on providing Guilds and Guildmates more things to do while rewarding them for working together as a team. In addition to Guild updates, there will also be a bunch of bug fixes (we’ll dive into some of those shortly) and updates to the backend which should help iron the last troublesome hiccups we saw during the Big Content Update.

[b]Guild System Update[/b]
Diving into the biggest part of this update, let’s talk a little about Guilds. As a team, we’ve heard the outcry from the community about the changes they’d like to see implemented and have been hard at work testing different things to see what does and doesn’t work. After numerous tests, we’ve been able to push through some quality of life changes, the biggest being an increase to two hours on the Guild Kiosk Buff. But don’t fret if the change you’d like to see isn’t there when the patch notes for the update are released! We’re attacking this problem systematically and are still working on the Guild system as a whole.

Now, quality of life changes are great, but the real meat of this update comes in the form of new Guild Missions that guilds can participate in. These missions will be randomly assigned to Guilds and work on a slightly different system than the missions you’re accustomed too. Instead of simply having players finish missions, the system is designed to reward Guilds that are able to get as many members as possible to participate and complete the mission. Essentially, you can think of it as a big mission that everyone in the guild and contribute participation too for a big reward once it’s completed.  

[b]Marketplace Fixes[/b]
After the introduction of the Marketplace, we’ve seen a few places where a little polish could go far and have made some adjustments to help make everyone’s life a lot easier. Besides not allowing players to list items that have already been used (for example a Shiny Stone that has even one hole used will not be allowed to be listed), we’ve made the descriptions a bit bigger and added a prompt to remind players to verify that the item they’re about to purchase is actually the item they want.

[b]Round Hole Records / Round Scores[/b]
It took a good amount of tinkering and a lot of sleepless nights, but I’ve gotten word that the score system has finally had the last of its bugs ironed out. Look forward to consistently seeing all your beautiful stats once the update goes live.

[b]Looking Ahead[/b]
And with that comes an end to this month’s letter from the Groundskeeper. We’ll be keeping an eye on the state of the game and constantly looking for feedback from the community since it’s you guys and gals who make this game as amazing as it is. Be sure to keep an eye out for the official Patch Notes that will come shortly before the actual update for a conclusive list of updates, changes, and fixes!

Where to leave feedback:
[list]
[*]Our Official [url=facebook.com/winningputt]Facebook[/url]
[*]Our Official [url=twitter.com/wputtgame]Twitter[/url]
[*]Our [url=forums.winningputtgame.com]Forums[/url]
[/list]
Best Wishes,
GM Takkun and The Winning Putt Team

notes.title: Letter From The Groundskeeper, April 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/0bb14b49b8efcc7084e19adce38cac3e6a6f7ed0.jpg[/img]
[h1]Your monthly update about all things Winning Putt for the month of April![/h1]

Hello Winning Putt Community!

After a few months of prepping and planning we’re back with your next Letter from the Groundskeeper! This one will cover what we have planned for the month of April and address some of the suggestions we’ve received from the community. More information after the break!

[b]Community Suggestions[/b]
After our last “mega” update, we’re scaling things back for the month April as we discuss and implement various fixes we’ve found through our internal testing as well as integrating the suggestions we’ve received from the community. Hand-in-hand with the Development Team, we’re hoping to bring some quality-of-life changes to the game as well address some issues that the community has been vocal about. While we can’t dive into specifics just yet, we do have our eyes on things like The Marketplace, Guild Kiosk functionality, and the Academy just to name a few.

[b]April Update[/b]
However, that doesn’t mean we don’t have some fun plans for the month of April! With the seasons changing and weather warming up, we have a bunch of new items ready to fly into the shops. After listening to the feedback from players, we’ve prepared a bunch of new apparel items to help you celebrate spring in [i]style[/i]. In addition to all that apparel will also be a new golf ball that draws inspiration from one of the most celebrated sports throughout the world. Last but not least, we also have a very spring-themed event in the works that we’re hoping ends up being rather [i]eggstravagent[/i].

[b]Looking Ahead[/b]
And with that comes an end to this month’s letter from the Groundskeeper. We’ll be keeping an eye on the state of the game and constantly looking for feedback from the community since it’s you guys and gals who make this game as amazing as it is.

Where to leave feedback:
[list]
[*]Our Official [url=https://www.facebook.com/WinningPutt/]Facebook[/url]
[*]Our Official [url=https://www.twitter.com/wputtgame]Twitter[/url]
[*]Our Official [url=http://forums.winningputtgame.com]Forums[/url](Come by and say hello if you haven’t already!)
[/list]
Best Wishes,
The Groundskeeper • GM Takkun

This weekend in Winning Putt, Players can get a [b]50% Bonus Platinum[/b] with each Platinum purchase and enjoy a [b]50% discount on all enchanting materials![/b]
