notes.title: Patch Notes: 03/09/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/5435fa7907dbc4556c446069ca705aeed69abaed.jpg[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes for March 9th, 2017[/h1]

After many rounds of testing and verifying that everything is working properly, we’re proud to present to you the [b]Patch Notes[/b] for [b]March 9th, 2017![/b] With spring quickly descending upon us, come celebrate with us as we unleash a wave of green onto the square. And while you’re at it, why not take a peek at the [b]brand new Marketplace?[/b]

[h1]New Additions and Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The level cap has been increased from 35 to 40.
[*] Level 40 equipment has been added to the game.
[*] Level 35+ missions have been added to the game.
[*] Level 35+ Achievements have been added to the game.
[*] The long awaited Marketplace has been added to the game!
[*] New Club Craft recipes have been added to the game.
 [*] Harsh Cape is out of beta and now officially open!
 [*] Harsh Cape has been added to the Course Master list.
[*] Players may now access Harsh Cape at Level 22. 
[*] Rewards for shooting a Hole-In-One, Albatross, or Eagle have been improved. 
[*] Fairway DR Skill has been adjusted [Increased Stamina and Mentality Cost]
[*] Warmer spring weather means the snow has melted away!
 [*] The snow has been removed from Edelweiss.
 [*] The snow has been removed from the Driving and Practice Range.
 [*] The snow has been removed from the Square.
[/list]
[h1]Rewards for shooting a Hole-In-One, Albatross, or Eagle have been improved.[/h1]
[list]
[*] Hole-in-One Reward Box Will Contain:
[list] 
[*] Apple (40 Accuracy), The One (4pc), Basic Accuracy Necklace, and Refined Leather.
[/list]
[*] Albatross Reward Box Will Contain:
[list]
 [*] Energy Bar (80 Swing), Power Distance (2pc), Shiny Stone (50 Hole), Titanium Alloy Rod Box, Refined Leather Box.
[/list]
[*] Eagle Rewards Reward Box Will Contain:
[list]
[*] Energy Bar (80 Swing), eXtreme Spin (3pc), Basic Power Necklace, and Titanium Alloy Rod
[/list]
[*] The amount of items you receive are based on the difficulty of the course you're playing on.
[*] Companions in your Companion Group will receive gold as well!
[/list]
[h1]Guild Related[/h1]
[list]
[*] Guild Name Change Tickets are now available at the Support Agency for 400,000 Gold.
[list]
 [*] Only the Guild Master can use the ticket to change the Guild Name.
[/list]
[*] The Guild Membership bug has been fixed and member counts should be accurate. 
[/list]
[h1]New Items[/h1]
[list]
[*] Character Name Change Tickets are now available at the Support Agency for 3,495 Platinum.
[*] Winter Costume Boxes are available at the Event Store for 795 Platinum until March 31st!
[list]
[*][b]Update for Clarity: You Only Get One Item per Box (Similar to other Lucky Boxes).[/b]
[/list]
[*] Grand Championship Tickets can now be used to craft Improved Founders Pack Equipment at the Craft-o-matic.
[list]
 [*] A Ticket will provide 1 Head Piece and 1 Top Piece.
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Smaller Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Ties during Ranked Rounds will now end in a draw.
[list]
 [*] Tie games will now result in each player earning 3 Ranked Points.
 [*] The controversial tie-breaker systems have been removed.
[/list]
[*] The rewards for Golden Ball or Lucky Ball have been improved.
[*] Ball animations have been sped up to reduce the time between each shot.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Guild Member counter now goes down after deleting a member.
[*] When UI is hidden, your character name will also be hidden.
[*] Course Master replay data has been updated with newer statistics. 
[*] Updated text and grammar throughout various Missions.
[/list]
[h1]**Known Issues**[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Marketplace shows an incorrect transaction fee of 20% after selling an item.
[list]
 [*] The Marketplace will actually charge the correct transaction fee of 5% for players with an active Gold Membership Contract, and 10% for all other players.
[/list]
[*] NPCs may disappear after using a Character Name Change Ticket.
[list]
 [*] Restarting the game will repair the issue and make the NPCs visable again.
[/list]
[*] Character name may not update on the Leaderboard after using a Character Name Change Ticket.
[list]
[*] A fix is in the works and the issue will be addressed at a later time.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: The Winning Putt Winter Event is Here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/d77457c9895f56db97cc9e66e32ac8a9a3481741.jpg[/img]

The Holidays are upon us and as the weather becomes more chilling many players have been waiting for Winning Putt’s new Winter Update. The wait is over now, and the Winter Update is upon us, as is the Winning Putt Holiday Event!

The Winning Putt Holiday Event will begin following maintenance on Thursday, December 15th, and is set to run throughout the holiday season and beyond! This event features special holiday decorations in The Winning Putt Square, a special event vendor with unique items available for Gold and Platinum, a Holiday Login Event and so much more!

[h1]Let it Snow[/h1]

Throughout this event, every round of Golf played on Edelweiss will feature snow! This special weather effect is only available on Edelweiss during this event, and provides a similar, but less pronounced penalty as playing in the Rain.

[h1]Holiday Presents[/h1]

One of our favorite things about the Holidays is the presents. In Winning Putt, you’ll have the chance to get yourself, or someone you know some great presents as well! In the center of the Winning Putt Square, players will have the opportunity to purchase a variety of special items from a new Special Event Vendor! This vendor will have a variety of unique items available for both Gold and Platinum, including Holiday themed costumes, and special Christmas Goody Bags and Present Boxes!

The Christmas Goody Bag will be available for 790 Platinum and is tradable so you can give them as gifts to your friends in game! Each Goodie Bag has a chance to contain special Holiday themed Golf Balls, Candy Canes, Green or Normal Quality Costume Boxes which include all of the previously released special event costumes, as well as the all new Santa Suit and Reindeer Suit Costumes, or the special Christmas Club Lucky Box which can contain any of the special Christmas themed clubs at level 12 or 35!

The Christmas Present Box can contain the same items that the Christmas Goody Bag contains, but is not tradable, and can be purchased for Gold!

Additionally, each day you login beginning on December 16th until December 28th you’ll get a special reward just for logging in!

[h1]Permanent Additions[/h1]

On top of these wonderful Holiday surprises, we’re making a few permanent additions to Winning Putt with this update as well. A new course, meant for players over level 20, Harsh Cape, will enter Beta with this update. Harsh Cape features long narrow fairways and some serious elevation changes to challenge our most veteran golfers. It will be available in beta mode for players level 15 and above following the update.

An all new crafting system will be implemented into the game as well. Players will be able to disassemble old unwanted clubs and insignias into parts which can then be used to create new and improved insignias and clubs for use in your next round of golf!

Both Harsh Cape and the new crafting system are free and permanent updates to Winning Putt! This makes our Winter Update one of the biggest updates yet, and we’re incredibly excited to share not only this update, but also the Holiday Season with all of you in Winning Putt!

notes.title: The Thanksgiving Championship Arrives
notes.content:
This holiday week, take part in Winning Putt’s first annual Thanksgiving Championship! The Thanksgiving Championship will take place beginning on Monday, November 21st, at 5:00 PM PST and continue until 1:00 PM PST on Monday, November 28th. In order to participate in this tournament players must be ranked Semi-Pro or above, and pay the 7,500 Gold participation fee. Players who choose to compete in this tournament will face off on Edelweiss’ beautiful 18 holes, played on the normal difficulty.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/ff1e240b4e47c955137dffaaa7f2210d71163dbd.jpg[/img]

Players who are unhappy with their initial score may purchase a re-participation ticket for either 150 Platinum or 5,000 Gold from the Winning Putt Support Shop. Using this ticket will allow players to re-participate in the tournament, replacing their prior score with the new score, regardless of whether it is better or not. Players who choose to use this option must ensure that their final scorecard is completed by 2:00 PM PST on Monday, November 28th for the score to register in the tournament results.

This year’s Thanksgiving Tournament features 750,000 Gold and 10,000 Ranked Tournament Points in prizing, which will be split amongst the top 100 players in the tournament. Do you think you have what it takes to win the first ever Thanksgiving Championship? Then give thanks, and compete for your chance to win!

notes.title: GPS Tips and Tricks
notes.content:
In Winning Putt, a golfer’s best friend may well be their GPS. You can make an argument for clubs or balls, but they’re nowhere near as useful without the abilities of the GPS.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/8b4d89ba1d03e55d9709882065ea628aa8be6a77.jpg[/img]

All players have access to a free basic GPS which allows them to check the target location of where their ball will land. This basic GPS shows a larger ring around the possible landing area with a smaller ring which has been slightly shaded in to show the target location. It’s even possible by paying careful attention to check the slope in the target location, as the smaller ring will tilt slightly to show more serious slopes in the target area.

However, a better option exists. Players can purchase a Premium GPS from Arnold’s Golf Supply Shop which provides increased detail when viewing the target location. When players have one of these items, in order to use it, all they need to do is slot it into one of their golf bag’s equipment slots. As long as the item is there, its functionality will replace that of the basic GPS all players have access to, greatly increasing the amount of information available. Players will be able to much better perceive the slope of the land, as the previous target area view will now show a grid, similar to what players experience on the putting green. The lines on the grid will have dots moving along the lines to indicate the slope of the ground at the target location. This provides a much more in depth view of the target area, allowing you to better account for slope at your target location. In addition to this, players will see an additional wind meter, better reminding them about the current wind speed and direction. All of this information combined together helps to ensure that you can aim your shot appropriately and spend less time playing on a less than idea lie.

Of course, we want to prove the usefulness of this item to you. So, tomorrow, Wednesday, November 9th, when you log in you’ll be getting a sample premium GPS when you log into Winning Putt. If you like playing with this item, which we think most of you will enjoy, you can buy a Premium GPS from Arnold’s Golf Supply Shop in the Winning Putt Square for 1,995 Platinum. Each Premium GPS lasts for 100 holes, or approximately six rounds of golf.

Enjoy your GPS, golfers! We’ll see you on the links!

notes.title: Maiphai Hills In-Depth Strategy: Hole 3
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/9d0d018975829ae38de9e4ff1d916f3b801b3cc8.jpg[/img]

Last week we continued our look at Winning Putt’s newest course, Maiphai Hills, with a basic strategy for tackling one of its par 5s, [url=https://winningputtgame.com/news/maiphai-hills-in-depth-strategy-hole-7]Hole 7[/url]. This week we want to explore the other end of the spectrum with Hole 3 of Maiphai Hills, the course’s first par 3.

Maiphai Hills’ 3<sup>rd</sup> hole is a medium length par 3 with a subtle dog leg. Sweet Shot or Straight Shot are incredible boons for most characters to have on this hole as they greatly increase your accuracy. In general, increasing your accuracy on short holes is very strong. However, if you’re a lower leveled accuracy character and can’t make the distance, you should make use of Power Shot.

Since this is a shorter hole, you shouldn’t need any stamina or mentality drinks. However, because accuracy is so key, you’ll want items that help you with that. 3 pc or even 4 pc golf balls are a great boon on this hole and won’t go to waste on the other holes on this course. A premium GPS will also help your aim and prepare you to compensate for wind. They’ll also help you judge your landing zone’s slope better.

Since it is possible to get a hole-in-one on this hole, your starting drive placement is very important. If you have a GPS, now is the time to use it. Because of the way the green is sloped, you’re going to want to aim a little short and a little to the right so that the ball will roll towards the hole. If you don’t make it in, all the accuracy increasing items or abilities you’ve used should keep you close to the hole so you can get an easy birdie.

Do you have a different strategy you use when taking on this hole? Let us know in the forums!

notes.title: 3 Piece Golf Balls Explained
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/9d0d018975829ae38de9e4ff1d916f3b801b3cc8.jpg[/img]

A couple of weeks ago, we [url=https://winningputtgame.com/news/4-piece-golf-balls-explained]discussed four piece golf balls[/url], and talked about the differences in play those types of balls offered over the standard one piece golf ball that we simulate with the free balls you always have available to you in Winning Putt. Today, we’re continuing that series with a discussion on three piece golf balls.

As a quick recap, just in case you haven’t read the prior article, one piece golf balls are standard only in that they’re the cheapest ball you can find. They’re typically just one solid piece of Surlyn, with dimples molded onto them. They’re durable, but even the most advanced player won’t be able to hit them as far as some other types of balls.

Four piece balls are comprised of four different layers, and are some of the highest performing balls players can use on a real golf course today.  In Winning Putt, these balls offer a mix of added distance and accuracy, as they work to reduce the run of the ball.

Three Piece balls are not surprisingly composed of three different layers. The physical product features a solid rubber or liquid core, followed by a layer of enhanced rubber, which is then covered by a high quality cover of Surlyn, Urethane, or similar material. These balls are softer and offer their user more spin, which the golfer can use to gain better control of the flight of the ball.
In Winning Putt, these balls focus on the added spin, helping to greatly reduce the run of the ball once it lands. This type of ball won’t provide players with the extra distance that a four or two piece ball would, but they do help greatly in placing the ball right where you want it to go.

Of course, we think that the best way to understand the effects these balls can have on your Winning Putt game is to try them out! To help with that, all players who log into Winning Putt today, November 2nd, will receive a free sample of 3 piece golf balls to use in their next round of golf in Winning Putt!

If you like the difference in play these balls offer, you can always purchase more at Arnold’s Golf Supply Shop in the Winning Putt Square! Arnold keeps a stock of two different kinds of three piece balls for players:

eXtreme Lightning: This ball offers all the performance of a three piece golf ball with a special lightning shot effect!

eXtreme Spin: Our “standard” three piece golf ball, with a special sparkling shot effect.

Both of these balls can be purchased for 1,495 Platinum per stack of 100 balls, consumed at a rate of one ball per hole played. To use them, simply equip them in one of the slots of your golf bag, and make sure to take note of how they affect your next round of golf in Winning Putt!

notes.title: Letter from the Groundskeeper: November, 2016
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/e3d93b97a753698c744da97a02e0acad4f1853d2.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the November 2016 edition of our Letter from The Groundskeeper! This past month has been jam packed with some great content, and we intend to keep going strong through the Month of November and beyond! As a reminder to our older fans, and a notice to our newer players, this article is meant to provide you with a quick peek into the future of Winning Putt. In general, we try not to discuss anything here that you won’t be seeing in the game within 90 days. However, game development and technology can be fickle creatures at times. If you don’t see something we talk about here in our next update, don’t worry! We’re still working on making Winning Putt the best game we can for you to enjoy.

[b]Winning Putt Live and on Steam[/b]

In case you missed it, Winning Putt recently exited Open Beta and celebrated its commercial launch! On top of this, we also launched Winning Putt on Steam, and since then we’ve been experiencing a large influx of new players. If you’re one of our long time veteran players, and see someone you don’t know wandering the Square, please feel free to take a moment to say “Hello and welcome to the game!” One of our favorite things about Winning Putt is our dedicated community, and we’re incredibly excited to grow that community!

[b]Turkey Comas Galore[/b]

November in America is known for a special holiday, Thanksgiving. Celebrated the fourth Thursday of every November, Thanksgiving is a time to celebrate with your family and friends, and be thankful for all that you have. In Winning Putt, the thing we’re most Thankful for is you, and your continued dedication to Winning Putt! To help celebrate this, we’re having a special Thanksgiving Tournament from November 21st through November 28th. During this tournament, we’ll also be holding a special login event with some great free items to say thanks to players both new and old. We hope you’ll enjoy the festivities, and want to thank you so much for spending some of your time playing Winning Putt. It really does mean the world to us.

[b]Another New Course?[/b]

We just released our newest course, Maiphai Hills to players in its beta phase. Players have been raving about this course since its launch, and we’re almost ready to take the course out of beta and into full release. This means that players will begin to see Maiphai Hills in more areas of Winning Putt, including Ranked Rounds, and Tournaments!

That doesn’t mean we’re done though. Maiphai Hills is meant for players who are a little lower level, and while all players may be able to enjoy its challenges, we want to provide something new for higher level players as well. To that end, we’re currently finishing the preparations to bring one of Winning Putt’s more challenging courses to our servers. Players can expect to see Harsh Cape be released into beta mode soon, and will have a chance to provide feedback before we fully release it into Ranked Rounds and Tournament play.

[b]New Crafting and Combining System[/b]

One of the things we’re hard at work on right now is introducing a new crafting/combining system to the game. We don’t have full details yet, but players can expect to be able to disassemble old unwanted gear and insignias in order to gain materials which can then be used to create new items. We’re really hoping this feature will allow players something better to do with their old clubs besides selling them for a few gold or letting them take up precious inventory space.

[b]Ongoing Optimization Efforts[/b]

The other big things we have our teams working on right now is further optimizing Winning Putt’s graphics, gameplay, and performance to help ensure players have a smoother experience over all. We understand that latency of any kind is something that players are really unhappy with experiencing, so we’ll be working on doing what we can on our end to improve performance across the board.

That’s it for this month’s Letter from the Groundskeeper! We hope you’ve enjoyed this quick look behind the curtains of Winning Putt’s development, and we’ll see you on the links golfers!

In addition to this, for the duration of this sale, all Shafts, Enchanting Materials, and Your Packs will be available for 20% off their normal Platinum purchase price!

SR Shafts add a sizeable amount of Tempo to your clubs, reducing the speed of the swing bar when using the club they are applied to. These are normally priced at 1,495 Platinum, but will be priced at 1,196 Platinum per Shaft this weekend!

White and Yellow Bolts are needed to enchant your clubs. Each rank of enchantment adds permanent stats to your club, as well as unlock your club set bonuses if they have them! All White and Yellow Bolt packages in the store are reduced by 20% this weekend only!

Grade Protection Tools are used to prevent a failed enchantment from downgrading the enchantment level of your club. notes.title: Volero Tour Season 1 Begins
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26150253/111d3a2e9bb468b91fdce535c9045589a28060c3.jpg[/img]

The first Season of Winning Putt’s Volero Tour is on! This season players will compete in six different tournaments beginning today with the RTB Classic and concluding with the Volero Championship, which begins on November 28th.

The RTB Classic will take place on Breezy Hill (Normal difficulty) beginning on October 27th at 7:00 PM PDT, and will run until November 3rd at 1:00 PM PDT. Players’ final scorecards must be submitted by 2:00 PM PDT in order to qualify for tournament entry.  To enter this tournament, players must pay the 5,000 Gold entry fee and complete all 18 holes of the course. This tournament will be open to all players and features a prize pool of 700,000 Gold and 5,000 Ranked Tournament points, both of which will be distributed amongst the top 100 players in the tournament.

Players who are unhappy with their score may purchase a re-participation ticket from Winning Putt’s Support Shop for 5,000 Gold or 150 Platinum. Using this ticket will allow players to re-participate in the tournament, replacing their current score with the new score, regardless of whether it is better or not.

For the full tournament schedule of Volero Tour’s Season 1, please see below:

notes.title: Winning Putt on Steam
notes.content:

This is a truly momentous occasion for those of us on the Winning Putt team and we’d like to thank our dedicated player base for providing us with feedback and helping us to reach this exciting milestone for Winning Putt!
